description: Libra decan 1 (September 23 to October 2): personality, love, work and growth, with Venus as sub-ruler of the first ten degrees of Libra.
answer: In Western astrology, the first decan of Libra covers 0° to 9° of the sign, roughly September 23 to October 2, with Venus as its sub-ruler, the sign's own planet. It is read as harmony, taste and partnership in their most concentrated form. Decans are a traditional refinement of the Sun sign.

sections.heading: Libra decan 1 personality
paragraphs: The first ten degrees of Libra are where the sign's ideals arrive undiluted. Venus is both the ruler of Libra and the sub-ruler of this opening decan, so astrologers traditionally read it as the most Venusian slice of the zodiac outside Taurus. That doubling tends to show up as a finely tuned sense of proportion: how a room is arranged, how a sentence lands, how fairly a bill is split. People here are often described as gracious hosts and natural go-betweens, alert to the emotional temperature of any gathering. They usually notice imbalance before anyone else does, and they feel it almost physically, like a picture hanging slightly crooked.

Because no second planet pulls in another direction, this decan's strengths and blind spots spring from the same source. The wish for harmony can make them superb at smoothing tension, yet it can also tempt them to agree too quickly so that a pleasant mood survives. Decision-making is a recurring theme: weighing options is enjoyable, choosing between them much less so. In the older literature this decan is linked with beauty, ornament and courtship, and many natives do treat good taste as a quiet form of ethics. At its best, Venus here produces someone whose kindness is practical, whose aesthetics are generous and whose fairness has a backbone.

sections.heading: Libra decan 1 in love and at work
paragraphs: In love, this decan tends to be romantic in the classic sense: thoughtful gestures, attention to atmosphere, a genuine pleasure in being a couple. Partnership often feels less like an add-on and more like the natural setting for their personality. The snag is that keeping the peace can become a full-time job. Small resentments may be tidied away rather than voiced, which works until it suddenly doesn't. Partners who invite honest disagreement, and show that a quarrel can be survived, usually bring out the best in them. Courtesy remains their native language of affection, but candour is what makes it last.

At work, doubled Venus favours roles where taste, tact and relationships carry weight. Design, curation, hospitality, client management, mediation and any job that involves presenting an idea attractively tend to suit them. They are often the colleague who rewrites the email so nobody takes offence, or who notices that a launch looks careless. Teams tend to trust their sense of fairness. The friction point is pace: they may hold back a decision until consensus forms, and consensus does not always arrive. Setting a personal deadline for choosing often frees them to use their judgement rather than endlessly refine it.

sections.heading: Dates and sub-ruler of Libra decan 1: what Venus adds
paragraphs: The first decan covers 0° to 9° of Libra, which in most years means birthdays from September 23 to October 2. First decans take the sign's own ruler, so Venus rules both the sign and this decan, which is why it is often called the purest expression of Libra. The other two decans of Libra belong to Uranus (decan 2) and Mercury (decan 3). Because decans are measured in degrees rather than days, the calendar dates drift by a day or so between years.

Venus contributes charm, taste and a pull towards harmony. Its decans tend to be pictured as more sociable and aesthetic, alert to beauty and fairness, and keen to soften conflict through diplomacy, pleasure and good company. Venusian decans are often linked with art, hospitality, partnership and style, and their usual lesson is to say what they want rather than smooth it over. Here Venus doubles up with the sign's own ruler, so Libra's fairness, charm, diplomacy and an eye for proportion come through with little filtering.

sections.heading: Growth for Libra decan 1
paragraphs: The growth edge for first-decan Libra is learning that peace and honesty are not opposites. A useful experiment is to name a preference early in a conversation, before reading the room, and see what happens; often very little goes wrong. Another is to notice when indecision is really a fear of disappointing someone. Writing down the actual cost of each option can turn vague weighing into a clear choice. None of this asks them to become blunt. It simply lets their famous diplomacy rest on firm ground, so that the harmony they create reflects what everyone, including them, really wants.

Within Libra, decan 2 leans towards fairness turned outward into ideals, networks and fresh social thinking and decan 3 leans towards diplomacy expressed through words, debate and nimble negotiation. A decan is one layer of a chart among many, so the Moon, rising sign and houses can strengthen or soften everything described here. These notes work best as prompts for reflection: notice which lines ring true, which feel foreign, and what that contrast suggests.

faq.question: Is the first decan of Libra the most typical Libra?
faq.answer: Traditionally, yes. With Venus acting as both sign ruler and sub-ruler, the first decan is often described as Libra at full strength: sociable, aesthetic and focused on fairness. Individual charts vary, though, so the Moon, rising sign and other placements always shade the picture.

faq.question: What are the dates of Libra decan 1?
faq.answer: In most years September 23 to October 2, the days when the Sun is between 0° and 9° of Libra. Birthdays at either end can fall in the neighbouring decan in some years.

faq.question: What planet rules Libra decan 1?
faq.answer: Venus. In the triplicity system each air sign's decans take the rulers of the air signs in order, starting with Libra's own ruler, Venus.
